name: Western Interdisciplinary Research Building utility-yard enclosure
summary: Long narrow single-storey white-roofed enclosure at the edge of a paved yard near aerial-visible equipment. No clear ground view establishes wall finish or function.

evidence.note: The southeast end has clipped corners. Across the 14 m roof, a few straight transverse seams and light staining interrupt a pale surface sampled at #dde3d9. Two freestanding units lie southwest of this footprint.
P50 3.68 m, P90 3.73 m and maximum 3.75 m support one level with a flat top.
Mapped as building=yes. No public label or street image establishes the exact function.

notes: Wall cladding is inferred from the roof and the adjoining equipment yard. The long white enclosure, the two freestanding units and the L-shaped screen are separate objects.
